I can still go into school and have a perfectly normal conversation about, oh, whether someone’s copied half their coursework from the internet—which they always think you won’t notice, as if we were born yesterday. But underneath it, I suppose I feel dulled rather than weepy.

So… I’m not sure. I wouldn’t want to say yes to being sad nearly every day if that’s not quite it.
